_note: Written BEFORE the evaluation ran. This is what keeps p-hacking, cherry-picking and after-the-fact stories out.
comparison: Old support prompt (v7) vs new support prompt (v8)
population: Realistic customer support conversations about returns, sampled from last month's traffic
null_hypothesis: The new prompt does not change the mean rubric score compared with the old prompt.
alternative: The new prompt changes the mean rubric score.
metric: Rubric score 0-10 per conversation, scored by the calibrated judge
sample: 100 test cases, each run through both prompts (paired)
test: Paired t-test on per-case differences; Wilcoxon signed-rank as a check for ordinal scores
decision_threshold: Ship only if the 95% CI for the improvement is above zero AND there is no new critical or policy failure
